data.define: Short for "not gonna lie", before an honest opinion.

misuse.text: Don't use 'ngl' in a job application.

data.l1_hook: Quel est ton avis honnête sur ce film ? « ngl »

native.tip: “ngl” = honnêtement. Exemple: “Ngl, I loved that movie.”
native.caption:
